description.zh: 分批次查询时每次显示的条目数。取值范围：**1**~**100**，默认值：**20**。
description.en: The number of entries to return on each page. Valid values: **1** to **100**. Default value: **20**.

description.zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：
- 第一次查询和没有下一次查询时，均无需填写。
- 如果有下一次查询，取值为上一次API调用返回的**NextToken**值。
description.en:
The token that determines the start point of the query. Valid values:

*   If this is your first query or no subsequent query is to be sent, ignore this parameter.
*   If a next query is to be sent, set the value to the value of **NextToken** that is returned from the last call.

description.zh:
流量标记策略的描述信息。

描述可以为空或长度为1～256个字符，不能以http://或https://开头。
description.en:
The description of the traffic marking policy.

This parameter is optional. If you enter a description, it must be 1 to 256 characters in length and cannot start with http:// or https://.
The ID of the traffic marking policy.

description.zh:
流量标记策略的名称。

名称可以为空或长度为1～128个字符，不能以http://或https://开头。
description.en:
The name of the traffic marking policy.

The name must be 1 to 128 characters in length, and cannot start with http:// or https://.
The ID of the transit router.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cbn list-traffic-marking-policies --transit-router-id tr-bp1rmwxnk221e3fas0000 --traffic-marking-policy-id tm-iz5egnyitxiroq0000 --traffic-marking-policy-name nametest --traffic-marking-policy-description desctest --max-results 20 --next-token FFmyTO70tTpLG6I3FmYAXGKPd0000 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun cbn ListTrafficMarkingPolicies --region cn-hangzhou --TrafficMarkingPolicyName nametest --NextToken FFmyTO70tTpLG6I3FmYAXGKPd0000 --TrafficMarkingPolicyId 'tm-iz5egnyitxiroq0000' --MaxResults 20 --TrafficMarkingPolicyDescription desctest --TransitRouterId 'tr-bp1rmwxnk221e3fas0000'
